entities.summary: Donka Ushlinova was a participant in the Bulgarian liberation movement in Macedonia. She was a Macedonian revolutionary, member and leader of the Macedonian Revolutionary Organization. She participated in the Ilinden Uprising, the Balkan Wars, and World War I. She later became a Non-commissioned officer in the Bulgarian army.
